about: Completes the constraint-type table for the conventions test (2026-11-27). The experts' tags on the examples repository use three constraint types the rulebook table lacks, and name two numbers differently. The added definitions are drafts written for this test, not upstream text; the experts should confirm them. The table data/constraint_types.json itself is not changed.

rename.name: thickness
rename.definition: the thickness of the layer or film of the constrained component on which the variable is measured

rename.name: min temperature
rename.definition: a minimum temperature that the constrained component must reach for it to count

add.name: volume
add.definition: the volume of the sample or portion of the constrained component on which the value is measured

add.name: composition
add.definition: what the constrained component consists of: its constituents or the mixture it is

add.name: purpose
add.definition: the purpose for which the constrained component is made, carried out or used
